hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Blocked: attempt to read .env file.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env files is not allowed."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])\.env([^a-zA-Z0-9_]|$)'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Blocked: attempt to read .env file.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env files is not allowed."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.path // ""'); if echo "$path" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Blocked: attempt to read .env file.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env files is not allowed."}}'; fi
